text: The Sun goes around the Earth.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: Does the Earth go around the Sun, or does the Sun go around the Earth?
room.note: 2012 survey; older data. Forced choice; 74% answered correctly, so the 26 includes the few who didn’t know.

truthSource.label: NASA Science, Solar System
truthSource.oneLine: The Earth orbits the Sun once a year.

lesson.tip: Everyday appearance (the Sun “rises”) can mislead. Check against established science, not the view from here.
